summary.text: Karen Reddington-Hughes represents the 66th District, which includes Bethlehem, Litchfield, Morris, Warren and Woodbury, and was re-elected to a second term in November 2024.

paragraphs.text: She has lived and worked in Woodbury since 1990, served two terms as Selectman, and has owned and operated Abrash Galleries on Main Street for more than 18 years.
She has also served as President of the Woodbury Antiques Dealers Association and of the Woodbury Chamber of Commerce.
